name_note: GTDB places this species in the split genus Blautia_A; the genomes in it carry the NCBI name Blautia obeum.

sentences.text: In a shotgun metagenomic study of 1,384 participants, Blautia obeum was more prevalent in the control group than among individuals with dyslipidemia.
Blautia obeum, Roseburia intestinalis and Akkermansia muciniphila were shown to be sources of antigens for the activation and priming of human DP8alpha regulatory T cells.
In an ancillary study of a rifaximin trial in severe cirrhosis, higher abundance of Blautia obeum at inclusion was associated with a lower incidence of spontaneous bacterial peritonitis.
In lipopolysaccharide-induced depression-like mice, oral administration of Blautia obeum was linked to antidepressant effects attributed to modulation of specific gut bacteria.
